commit_binding: Exact source hashes; pending parent integration commit
scope: Independent review of root-authored global finite append-root count and actual Upsilon bound; underlying authored Args/Cert/Extract retain independent reviewer receipts.
checks: IsAppendFrame requires an actual XiAt occurrence, full pinned XiCall inputs, non-SYSTEM source, exact deposit184/exit48 calldata and actual local Xi success. It does not accept a supplied list or storage/event postcondition as frame evidence.

owns_event extracts the same located Xi certificate and invokes successful_append_address on it, then transports its continuation-only event back to the original tree. FrameRoot is derived from actual traversal.
Owner candidate construction is noncircular: owner_coverage derives that every qualifying frame owns an actual marked event, independently of membership in frames.

frames filters the finite event-owner image by IsAppendFrame. mem_frames_iff proves exact equivalence to the unrestricted predicate, so no qualifying actual root is omitted by the finite construction.

Cardinality of the filtered owner set is at most event list length. Repeated local markers of one frame or multiple witnesses for the same path count once; no arbitrary subcollection or injectivity assumption is supplied.

owned_distinct separates different frame paths even for ancestor/descendant pairs. Independently reviewed XiAt.identity establishes unique full invocation at a fixed path, preventing physical-invocation identity from being confused with repeated witnesses.

Rollback does not filter frames: only the located Xi local success is tested, not enclosing status or final committed logs/storage. CREATE post-child rejection and ancestor rollback retain their locally successful descendants.

Runtime clones and delegated executions of pinned bytes are deliberately included, as now explicitly documented. This is a conservative work superset of canonical predeploy appends, not a canonical-address theorem.

Transaction conclusion composes count_le_events with the same actual extracted Upsilon tree and its capped-refund event bound. No aggregate hcharged premise, final status=true requirement or committed-record assertion is introduced.
scope_limits: Noncomputable finite set is a logical exact count, not executable frame enumeration.
Predicate covers actual pinned runtime invocations at any owner; canonical deployment/storage-owner eligibility is separate.
Counts locally successful calls even if later rolled back, not committed queue records.
Raw Context does not assert transaction admission, valid blocks, scheduling, funding or intermediate storage domains.

next_history_interface.recommendation: A checkpointed protected-storage invariant over literal transaction/nested request entry and settlement cuts, with actual Theta pre/post-world adapters and XiAt-to-call linkage. Do not flatten nested calls into ConcreteHistory.Trace, whose full-world contiguity cannot express external-frame interleaving and ancestor rollback.
required_edges: Canonical admitted call linkage and installed-code/storage-owner identity
Audited frame local preservation from existing User/System invariant lemmas
Actual non-owner instruction/wrapper protection of canonical slots and code
Rollback to an actual earlier checkpoint while retaining monotone executed-frame budget via AccountedState.mono
Prefix append-root accounting bounded by complete transaction count and then valid block/history gas totals
next_history_interface.fuel_hazard: Pinned CREATE catches Lambda.OutOfFuel and substitutes empty world. An enclosing completed result alone may not exclude protected-account deletion if later execution makes world nonempty. Independently verify the proposed long-init/short-second-CREATE scenario; history applicability needs derived fuel adequacy or explicit handling, not an assumed desired postcondition.
next_history_interface.status: Design advice only; no history extraction/preservation proof claimed
